description: This file defines various parameter classes and types used in FastAPI for handling request parameters such as query, path, header, cookie, and request body, including their validation and schema details.

classes.name: ParamTypes
classes.description: Enumeration of parameter locations in HTTP requests (query, header, path, cookie).

classes.name: Param
classes.description: Represents a request parameter with validation and schema options.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Parameter class for path parameters, cannot have default values.

classes.name: Body
classes.description: Represents request body data with schema and validation options.

classes.name: File
classes.description: File upload parameters, inherits from Form.

classes.name: Depends
classes.description: Dependency injection class for request dependencies.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Security dependency class, inherits from Depends.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes parameter classes with validation and schema options.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Returns string representation of parameter instances.
